title: Mark Zuckerberg's creative plan to pay California’s proposed billionaire tax without losing control of Meta | TechCrunch
summary: During Meta’s earnings call on Wednesday, the company revealed its board had approved a new class of non-voting stock, called Class C common stock. The filing says that as far back as July, Zuckerberg was discussing the billionaire tax with board members.
